Betel  Psycheldelic
6 hours after eating 5 grams of dried cubensis I chewed up one Betel Nut as quickly as possible. Immediately I knew I needed to spit it our or swallow it all with juice. I swallowed it. I decided to go to town. On my way I realizes I was still hallucinating more. I felt very good after one hour but was still hallucinating more than nine hours after I ate the mushrooms. I couldn't sleep until 15 hours had passed. I don't think I will do it again. It was interesting. I might try eating the Betel Nut without mushrooms or with lime someday.
